items.text: Understand the four cloud deployment models (public, private, hybrid, community) and when to use each
Can explain the difference between a data center and cloud computing
Know the three cloud service models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) and their responsibility boundaries
Understand the Shared Responsibility Model and who manages what
Grasp what virtualization is and how it works with hypervisors
Know the difference between Type 1 and Type 2 hypervisors
Understand how cloud providers use virtualization for multi-tenancy and elastic scaling
Can identify which cloud deployment model fits specific business requirements
Able to differentiate between IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS services in AWS
Can determine customer vs provider responsibilities for any cloud scenario
Know how to calculate cost savings from virtualization consolidation
Can explain when to use bare metal vs virtualized instances
Understand how to navigate AWS console to explore different service models
Can explain public cloud characteristics and major providers (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Know that customer is ALWAYS responsible for data security and encryption regardless of service model
Understand that IaaS requires customer to patch OS, while PaaS and SaaS are provider-managed
Can identify AWS services by type: EC2 (IaaS), Elastic Beanstalk (PaaS)
Know virtualization efficiency gains: from 10-15% to 60-80% utilization
